name: TAIWAN VIX variance-risk-premium semantics and validation contract

coreCorrection.statement: TAIWAN VIX level is not the variance risk premium.
coreCorrection.decomposition: option-implied variance contains both expected future physical variance and compensation for bearing variance/tail risk.
coreCorrection.consequence: VIX minus trailing realized volatility is a contemporaneous implied-realized spread proxy, not ex-post or structural VRP.

IMPLIED_VARIANCE.definition: risk-neutral forward variance proxy from option prices
IMPLIED_VARIANCE.liveEligibility: same-session official VIX can be PIT-eligible when timestamped/captured before the decision clock

TRAILING_REALIZED_VARIANCE.definition: past-only realized variance estimator using data known by decision time
TRAILING_REALIZED_VARIANCE.guard: window and estimator frozen before outcome testing

FUTURE_REALIZED_VARIANCE.definition: realized variance over the future horizon corresponding to the option-implied horizon

IMPLIED_REALIZED_SPREAD_PROXY.definition: implied variance minus a frozen past-only physical-variance forecast/proxy
IMPLIED_REALIZED_SPREAD_PROXY.guard: do not label structural VRP unless physical expectation model is validated

EX_POST_VARIANCE_PREMIUM.definition: implied variance at t minus subsequently realized future variance
EX_POST_VARIANCE_PREMIUM.guard: look-ahead if used as predictor at t

literatureAnchors: Bekaert-Hoerova: VIX can be decomposed into conditional variance and equity variance premium; components have different economic information.
Bollerslev-Zhou/Fed: implied-minus-realized variance predictability is horizon-sensitive and measurement-sensitive; model-free implied variance and high-frequency realized variance matter.
International evidence: variance-risk-premium return predictability has appeared across several developed markets, but portability to Taiwan is an empirical question, not assumed.
firstTaiwanQuestion: Does option-implied risk pricing add incremental risk-state information beyond Taiwan realized-volatility/Regime controls?
falsification: If VIX adds no value beyond realized volatility/Regime, classify REDUNDANT.
If implied-realized spread adds no value beyond VIX level/change, reject extra complexity.
If only ex-post future realized variance creates the result, classify LOOK_AHEAD.
If effect is crisis-only, classify REGIME_SPECIFIC rather than universal.
Use independent trading dates; overlapping multi-day targets require HAC/block/bootstrap or non-overlapping robustness.
No threshold/window/model selected from outcome performance.

maturityDecision.promotionToL3: requires validated Taiwan PIT receipt/replay feasibility for the frozen VIX + realized-vol inputs, not merely conceptual literature support

exactNextContinuation: Freeze the smallest prospective VIX receipt implementation boundary and check whether an isolated Class-A research capture already exists.
Do not buy long-history data before prospective source/quality coverage demonstrates usefulness.
Cross-test VIX and implied-realized spread against D04 realized-volatility states without outcome-driven threshold tuning.
Then return to D12-10 NIGHT_PRE_SCAN prospective receipt so derivative-risk and after-hours absorption can be tested jointly.
